items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Anthropic IPO Prices High, Palo Alto, Everpure Jump After Market Mixed On Nvidia, Target, UnitedHealth, Fed 'Shock'
items.summary: The stock market was mixed as UnitedHealth dived and Nvidia fell. The Anthropic IPO priced high. Palo Alto, Everpure leaped.

items.title: Walmart Earnings Could Add to Its Winning Streak
items.summary: Analysts are looking for Walmart to earn 64 cents a share on revenue of $187.3 billion.
